selection.strategy: Purposive maximum-variation benchmark, not a systematic review or prevalence estimate.
selection.eligibility: Peer-reviewed HCI work with an implemented or concretely specified personalization route, an identifiable comparator or consequence, and sufficient primary-source reporting to fill the frozen route schema.
variation_axes: lab versus field or case-study use
selection.coding_boundary: Authors of the present manuscript coded public reports. The source authors did not validate these encodings, and no independent second coder was available.

sources.title: A Comparison of Static, Adaptive, and Adaptable Menus
sources.reported_evidence: Controlled lab study with 27 participants; static was faster than adaptive, adaptable was faster than adaptive in some orders, and most participants preferred adaptable.

sources.title: Automatically Generating Personalized User Interfaces with Supple
sources.reported_evidence: Automatically generated interfaces were compared with manufacturer defaults and improved speed, accuracy, and satisfaction for people with motor impairments.

sources.title: Improving Performance, Perceived Usability, and Aesthetics with Culturally Adaptive User Interfaces
sources.reported_evidence: Evaluation with 41 users found faster task performance, fewer clicks and errors, and preference for the culturally adapted website over a non-adapted version.

sources.title: Embracing Calibration in Body Sensing: Using Self-Tweaking to Enhance Ownership and Performance
sources.reported_evidence: Two in-use body-sensing case studies showed teachers and pupils using exposed calibration to set goals and shape the technology to their bodies.

sources.title: Adapting User Interfaces with Model-based Reinforcement Learning
sources.reported_evidence: A conservative adaptive-menu policy was evaluated empirically and in simulation against non-adaptive and frequency-based policies.

sources.title: Exploring the Role of Interaction Data to Empower End-User Decision-Making in UI Personalization
sources.reported_evidence: Twelve interview participants considered synthetic-data vignettes; preferences and design considerations were elicited, but no functional personalized system or real task benefit was tested.

cases.proposed_use_en: Use frequency-and-recency adaptation instead of the evaluated static split menu.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 以频率和近期使用驱动的自适应替代已评估静态 split menu。
cases.evidence_basis_en: The adaptive menu was slower than the static comparator; the study therefore supplies route-specific negative evidence rather than missing data.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 自适应 menu 慢于静态比较方案，因此这是路径特定的负证据，而非缺失数据。

cases.proposed_use_en: Offer user-controlled split-menu customization in the evaluated menu task.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 在已评估 menu 任务中提供用户控制的 split-menu 定制。
cases.evidence_basis_en: Participants could customize effectively in the tested task, adaptable menus beat adaptive menus in some orders, and most participants preferred the adaptable condition.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 参与者可在测试任务中有效定制；可调 menu 在部分顺序中优于自适应 menu，且多数参与者偏好可调条件。

cases.proposed_use_en: Generate reversible interfaces for users whose motor abilities are poorly served by manufacturer defaults.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 为不适合厂商默认界面的运动障碍用户生成可逆界面。
cases.evidence_basis_en: Compared with manufacturer defaults, the evaluated interfaces improved speed, accuracy, and satisfaction for the target population.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 相对厂商默认界面，已评估界面改善了目标人群的速度、准确性与满意度。

cases.proposed_use_en: Use the evaluated cultural adaptation for the tested website tasks and populations.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 在测试网站任务与人群中使用已评估文化自适应。
cases.evidence_basis_en: The adapted condition improved observed task performance and subjective experience against the non-adapted website in the evaluated sample.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 在已评估样本中，自适应条件相对非自适应网站改善了任务表现与主观体验。

cases.label_zh: 用户塑造的身体传感校准
cases.proposed_use_en: Expose calibration so teachers and learners can shape goals and system behavior in the evaluated physical-skill setting.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 开放校准，使教师和学习者在已评估身体技能场景中塑造目标与系统行为。
cases.evidence_basis_en: Two in-use cases directly examined how exposed calibration supported ownership and goal setting rather than treating calibration as hidden setup.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 两个真实使用案例直接考察了开放校准如何支持掌控感与目标设定，而非把校准当作隐藏设置。

cases.label_zh: 保守型模型驱动 menu 自适应
cases.proposed_use_en: Use the conservative policy in the evaluated adaptive-menu setting.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 在已评估自适应 menu 场景中使用保守策略。
cases.evidence_basis_en: The conservative policy was designed to avoid changes when none were beneficial and outperformed non-adaptive and frequency-based policies in the reported evaluations.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 保守策略被设计为在无益时不改变，并在报告评估中优于非自适应与频率策略。

cases.proposed_use_en: Deploy interaction-data-driven visual personalization suggestions with user acceptance and refinement.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 部署由交互数据驱动、可由用户接受和调整的可视个性化建议。
cases.evidence_basis_en: Participants preferred supported, transparent suggestions in interviews, but the vignettes used synthetic data and did not test a functional system or task benefit.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 访谈参与者偏好有支持且透明的建议，但 vignette 使用合成数据，未检验功能系统或任务收益。
